name: Default
shortDescription: Visual builder to create, deploy and monitor AI agent workflows, with realtime collaboration, PostgreSQL with pgvector, Redis and a background job scheduler.

alerts.message: Sign-up is open to anyone who can reach the URL. Create your account first, then set DISABLE_REGISTRATION to true and redeploy to block new sign-ups.
Agent blocks need an LLM provider API key, entered in each Agent block. No mail provider is configured, so invitations and password resets are not delivered until you add one.
